'''''Euphorbia cooperi''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the [[Euphorbiaceae]] family.<ref name=KewPOWO>{{cite web|url= https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:346111-1|title= Euphorbia cooperi N.E.Br. ex A.Berger|author=<!--Not stated-->|date=n.d.|website=Plants of the World Online|publisher=The Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew|access-date= August 22, 2020}}</ref> It is commonly called '''Transvaal candelabra tree''' or '''bushveld candelabra euphorbia''',<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.plantzafrica.com/plantefg/euphorbcoop.htm |title=PlantZAfrica.com |access-date=6 August 2014}}</ref> and is found in South Africa.
